decisions: Attribute the June 2026 $1.79T adjusted volume and 67% USDC share to Cointelegraph's July 6 report of Visa/Allium data.
Attribute the H1 2026 $8.82T adjusted volume and approximately 70% USDC share to Finst's July 6 report of Visa/Allium data.
Preserve the prior Cointelegraph source record unchanged and append a limitation that corrects its H1 attribution.
Keep Circle's 77% June volume-share statement as a company-reported metric with a different/undisclosed adjustment method.
Do not treat raw/issuer-reported transaction volume and Visa adjusted volume as interchangeable; do not admit either as an XRP price feature.
rationale: Direct inspection of the Cointelegraph article supports June-only figures.
Direct inspection of the Finst article supports the H1 figures.
Visa's own dashboard explains adjusted-volume filters, providing methodology context.
next_action: Seek direct Visa/Allium downloadable historical data and a common chain/transaction filter definition; retain source-specific series until reconciled.
